semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Bronkhorst Japan specializes in mass flow and pressure measurement solutions, which are critical for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bronkhorst Japan Co., Ltd. provides advanced mass flow and pressure measurement instruments essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their products are utilized in R&D and industrial applications, ensuring precise control of gases and liquids in various environments.
capabilities: Thermal mass flow meters/controllers for gases
Coriolis mass flow meters/controllers for liquids
Customized measuring solutions for low-flow applications

regional_presence.Japan: Bronkhorst Japan K.K. operates sales and service offices in Tokyo and Osaka, providing local support and training.
